sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State, on instruction, submits that notice has been served on the informant/victim on 19.07.2023 indicating therein that the matter shall be taken up on today (17.08.2023).
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
3.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Spl. G.R. Case No.13 of 2023, pending in the file of learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack, arising out of Mahila P.S. UPD Cuttack Case No.10 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(1)/376(2)(n)/363/366-A/323/506/34 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Mahila P.S. UPD Cuttack Case No.10 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Cuttack by order dated 21.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 10.02.2023 and as charge sheet has been filed on 27.03.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: 7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.

8. Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
